texts.preamble: Sri Sai Pyro World vs The District Revenue Officer And on 6 June, 2024 Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.11662 of Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 06.06.2024 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.11662 of 2024 and W.M.P(MD)No.10409 of 2024 Sri Sai Pyro World, Represented by its Partner N.Sakthivel Rajan, Door No.61-R, Gandhi Road, Sivakasi Town, Sivakasi Taluk, Virudhunagar District. ... Petitio Vs. 1.The District Revenue Officer and Additional District Magistrate, Virudhunagar District, Virudhunagar. 2.The Special Tahsildar (Matches and Fireworks Investigation), Sivakasi, Virudhunagar District. 3.The Village Administrative Officer, V.Muthulingapuram Village, Virudhunagar Taluk, Virudhunagar District. ... Respond https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 1/6 Sri Sai Pyro World vs The District Revenue Officer And on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89048117/ 1 W.P(MD)No.1 Prayer: Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitutio India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to de the main entrance gate leading to the petitioner's cracker shop and unlock and provide open access to the petitioner to the petitioner' cracker shop in reference to License No. 126/2022 in Form Le-5 situ in S.No. 262/2, V.Muthulingapuram Village, Virudhunagar Taluk and District and consequently permit the petitioner to peacefully run t business operation in the petition mentioned cracker shop. For Petitioner : Mr.N.Dhilipkumar For Respondents : Mr.N.GA.Natraj Government Advocate Order
texts.arguments: 2.The second respondent herein sealed the petition mentioned premises on the ground that the petitioner was found to manufacture crackers in violation of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would strongly plead that the manufacture of the crackers is not in contravention of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
